cose.chi.testo: This installation of cleanvid is run by {gestore}.
cose.fa.testo: You give it the address of a page with a video in it. cleanvid finds the video inside that page and opens it on its own: no popups, no banners, no ad breaks stitched into the stream. What you open stays in your history, which is yours and nobody else's. You can watch several videos at once, and open a room to watch them with other people.
cose.non_fa.1: It hosts and uploads no video. It shows what the original site is already serving, without the frame around it. If that site stops, cleanvid has nothing to show.
cose.non_fa.2: It has no catalogue and searches for nothing on your behalf. There is nothing to browse: you always start from an address you bring.
cose.non_fa.3: It circumvents no protection. DRM content stays in its own apps, and there is no attempt to reach anything that requires a subscription or an access you don't have.
cose.non_fa.4: It does not remove ads inside another platform's player. When you use their player, their ads stay: on the web, one site cannot reach inside another site's page.
cose.responsabilita.testo: With whoever opens the link. cleanvid is a tool: it does what you ask with the address you give it, and it knows nothing about the rights to that content. Whoever uses it must have the right to watch what they open.
cose.segnalazioni.testo: If something reachable from here infringes your rights, or if something is wrong, write to this address. Include the exact link: without it there is nothing to act on.
cose.sommario: A tool for watching a video you have already found, without everything that surrounds it.
entra.accedi.testo: Signing in takes you back to your account. What you opened in this anonymous session stays where it is: it isn't carried over, because on a borrowed computer that would be an unpleasant surprise.
entra.guaio.credenziali: That email and password don't match.
entra.guaio.email_strana: That doesn't look like an email address.
entra.guaio.email_usata: This email already has a login. If it's yours, sign in instead of signing up.
entra.guaio.gia_registrato: This account already has a login.
entra.guaio.password_corta: That password is too short. A long password beats a complicated one.
entra.guaio.troppi_tentativi: Too many attempts. Try again in a quarter of an hour.
entra.registrati.testo: Signing up doesn't create a new account: it attaches an email and a password to the account you're already using. History, favourites and groups stay yours, because they always were.
entra.sommario: It's what lets you find your things on another device, and open rooms. What you already have stays untouched.
guarda.attesa_annuncio: An ad is running: we're stripping it out. The video resumes the moment it ends.
guarda.condivisibile: This address can be saved and sent to someone.
guarda.in_cronologia: It's in your history: you'll find it on the home page, under your profile.
guarda.loro.spiega: Starts at once and never expires, but the platform's ads stay and the controls are theirs.
guarda.niente.testo: The site offers no embeddable player, and extraction found nothing playable.
guarda.niente.titolo: No video came out of this link
guarda.niente_flusso: This browser can't play this stream.
guarda.nostro.spiega: Our own player: no platform frame, spoken sponsor segments are skipped, and picture-in-picture and resume work. It takes a few seconds longer.
home.come.1.testo: Any page with a video in it: a platform you know, or some site you've never heard of.
home.come.2.testo: If the site offers an official player we use that. Otherwise we extract the stream and serve it clean.
home.come.3.testo: No popups, no banners, no ads stitched into the stream. Just the video, full screen if you want.
home.faq.1.d: Do I need to sign up?
home.faq.1.r: No. The moment you arrive you already have your own account, with your own history. If one day you want a login, it attaches to the account you already have: you lose nothing by signing up.
home.faq.2.r: No, and there are no ads. It's an open project: the code is there to read.
home.faq.3.d: Does it work on phones and tablets?
home.faq.3.r: Yes, from the browser, nothing to install. On iPhone and iPad the sound starts on your first tap, because the system insists on it.
home.faq.4.d: Does it really remove the ads?
home.faq.4.r: The ones stitched into the stream, yes: we strip them as the playlist passes through us, and those are precisely the ones no browser blocker can see. Inside a platform's own official player, though, the platform's ads stay.
home.faq.5.r: No. cleanvid hosts nothing and uploads nothing: it shows what the original site already serves, without the frame around it.
home.guida: Paste a page's address and only the video is left. What you open goes into your history, which is yours and nobody else's: you already have an account, without doing anything.
home.vuoto: Nothing yet. The first link you open shows up here.
home.vuoto.preferiti: Nothing yet. The star on a cover brings it here.
impostazioni.guida: These apply to this browser and to your profile. None of these choices leave this machine.
impostazioni.lingua.guida: This also changes the page addresses: each language has its own, so it can be saved and shared.
marchio.motto: Just the player. Everything else, gone.
meta.cose.descrizione: cleanvid opens a page's video and strips everything else. It hosts no content, has no catalogue and searches for nothing: it opens what you give it.
meta.cose.titolo: What cleanvid is — and what it isn't
meta.entra.descrizione: Attach a login to what you already have: your history and favourites stay exactly where they are.
meta.home.descrizione: Paste a page's link and only the video is left: no popups, banners or ad breaks. Free, no sign-up, on computer, phone and tablet.
